caseStudies.title: Vidya: Digital Classrooms in Javadhu Hills
caseStudies.problem: Over 85% of tribal students in Javadhu hills lacked access to basic computer literacy and internet connectivity, leading to high school dropout rates.
caseStudies.solution: Established 5 fully-equipped digital learning centers with solar power backups, hardware systems, and local coordinators.
caseStudies.results: 94% drop in school dropouts, and over 1,200 tribal children trained in basic computer skills.
caseStudies.quote: This center has opened a new world for our children. They now look forward to school every single day.
caseStudies.author: M. Raman, Village Head

caseStudies.title: Prakriti: Water Conservation in Salem District
caseStudies.problem: Severe seasonal water scarcity in agricultural villages caused crop failures and community migration during dry summer months.
caseStudies.solution: Constructed 3 check dams and desilted 5 community temple tanks to recharge the local groundwater table.
caseStudies.results: 40% increase in seasonal crop yield and reliable groundwater access for 4 adjacent villages.
caseStudies.quote: We did not have water to drink in May. Now our wells are full, and we are harvesting double crops.
caseStudies.author: K. Sidhan, Farmer Union Lead
